# OAuthSession

Pending OAuth request details for the consent screen (MCP connector).

2 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

## Operations

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/oauth/session/request`](#op-oauthsession-getconsentrequest) | OAuthSession_GetConsentRequest |
| POST | [`/api/oauth/session`](#op-oauthsession-createsession) | OAuthSession_CreateSession |

<a id="op-oauthsession-getconsentrequest"></a>
### GET `/api/oauth/session/request`

operationId `OAuthSession_GetConsentRequest` · Describes the pending authorization request so the consent screen can show who is asking
and for what.

Everything shown on the consent screen is resolved here rather than parsed out of the
browser's address bar: the client name comes from the client record, and the redirect URI
is re-checked against that record. A caller cannot therefore pair a trusted client's name
with a redirect URI belonging to someone else.

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `returnUrl` | query | string |  | The authorization request the user was redirected away from, exactly as the authorization endpoint handed it to the consent page. |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [OAuthConsentRequestDetails](#schema-oauthconsentrequestdetails) | The client, redirect target and requested scopes. |
| `400` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) |  |

<a id="op-oauthsession-createsession"></a>
### POST `/api/oauth/session`

operationId `OAuthSession_CreateSession` · Establishes the OAuth consent session for the currently signed-in user.

Authenticated with the web UI's JWT - the only thing this proves, and the only thing it
needs to prove, is who is consenting. The authorization code is still minted by
OpenIddict at the authorization endpoint, and PKCE still binds it to the requesting agent.

Parameters: _none_

Request body `request` (application/json), **required**: [OAuthConsentRequest](#schema-oauthconsentrequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | — | No content on success. |
| `400` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) |  |

<a id="schema-oauthconsentrequestdetails"></a>
### OAuthConsentRequestDetails

What the consent screen shows about a pending authorization request.

Required: `isLoopbackRedirect`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | string |  | Gets or sets the identifier of the client requesting access. |
| `clientName` | string |  | Gets or sets the display name of the client, falling back to its identifier. |
| `redirectUri` | string |  | Gets or sets the redirect URI the authorization code would be sent to. |
| `redirectHost` | string |  | Gets or sets the host component of RedirectUri. |
| `isLoopbackRedirect` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the redirect URI points at the local machine. |
| `scopes` | string[] |  | Gets or sets the scopes the client asked for, restricted to the ones this server knows. |
